Its edge is speed and protein expression know-how. ExcellGene also licenses its own proprietary cell hosts, CHOExpress and HEKExpress.

ARCHIMED took a majority stake in ExcellGene in late 2025.

The role

ExcellGene is hiring a Vice President Product & Marketing to build its product and marketing function and drive the next phase of growth. This is a new role, reporting into the Chief Executive Officer and part of the Executive Leadership Team, to turn product & strategy into a clear offer and steady demand, working side by side with the Vice President of Global Business Development & Sales and the Chief Scientific & Technology Officer

Key responsibilities

  • Market & customer insight: understand customers, market segments, competitors and emerging opportunities.
  • Portfolio & product strategy: shape portfolio around market needs and ExcellGene’s scientific strengths.
  • Positioning & value proposition: clearly articulate why customers should choose ExcellGene.
  • Go-to-market: define and drive GTM strategies for core business and new growth areas.
  • Demand creation: build effective lead-generation programs and targeted campaigns.

  • New growth platforms: identify and develop new organic opportunities and support the assessment and integration of potential acquisitions.

This person will connect market, portfolio, positioning, go-to-market and lead generation. He/she will decide where ExcellGene plays, why it wins, and where the next growth platforms come from.

Requirements

Must have

  • A scientific background and education, ideally combined with a business or marketing qualification.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in product and marketing, including 3-5 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong product and marketing experience in biologics. Cell-line development or protein expression is highly valued.
  • Experience in a CRO, CDMO or other scientific services business, selling development services alongside products.
  • Product marketing and broader marketing, with go-to-market experience at both strategic and hands-on level.
  • The ability to turn complex science into clear customer value and a sharp commercial offer.
  • A start-up mindset: think strategically, do the work yourself and bring an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach.
  • Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work effectively with scientific, commercial and operational teams.

Nice to have

  • Good understanding of the US market and of Asian markets (India is a plus).

Benefits

  • Location: Monthey, Switzerland
  • Working model: Hybrid, on site 3 days per week, ideally Tuesday to Thursday

title: Founding Platform Engineer
description: We are hiring on behalf of our client, a fast-growing innovator in the crypto and decentralized finance space who is seeking a Founding Platform Engineer (Staff+ level) to join the team. This organization is behind a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) on HyperEVM, having achieved significant revenue milestones with an ultra-lean team. The client is now expanding its technical architecture to build an advanced, mobile-first crypto trading platform (spot + perps) alongside a novel, original social product featuring cutting-edge mechanisms. As the first and only engineer in this specialized domain, the incoming candidate will take an original product vision and turn it into a robust, high-performance system—holding the entire architecture and the smallest details simultaneously. The operational environment is primarily asynchronous, highly independent, and built for top-tier developers who can scale infrastructure from zero to massive daily trading volumes while maintaining absolute reliability. Requirements Platform Ownership: Own the core platform, including the data layer, rewards engine, notifications, the API surface, and overall system reliability. Trading Engine Integration: Integrate perpetual trading engines through Hyperliquid, alongside spot trading via Jupiter and Relay. Data Harmonization: Aggregate and unify conflicting data providers (such as Zerion, CoinGecko, Mobula, Alchemy, and Hyperliquid) into a single, cohesive source of truth. High-Performance Data Delivery: Serve heavy data rapidly by implementing resilient caching mechanisms that survive traffic stampedes and fan-out structures that hold under pressure. Cross-Chain Abstraction: Design architecture that makes a single USDC balance across multiple chains entirely invisible and seamless to the end user. Peak Performance & Reliability: Maintain absolute uptime during peak market volatility; ensure the application never lags or crashes when it matters most, guaranteeing users can always close positions. Requirements Proven track record of engineering resilience, including keeping a high-stakes system alive through massive traffic spikes and determining graceful degradation strategies in advance. Extensive experience building financial rewards and accounting systems that withstand retries, prioritizing idempotency, replay safety, and precise lot tracking. Deep understanding of end-to-end latency budgets (from a user's tap to screen rendering). Advanced database optimization skills, capable of resolving bottlenecks directly within PostgreSQL rather than relying on secondary databases. Strong proficiency in Rust development. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment across North American or European timezones. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Top-market base salary paired with significant equity upside. Flexible & Remote-First Work: 100% remote working model with flexible schedules and high operational autonomy. title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Location: Germany (remote)

Reports to: RVP Sales

Languages: native/C2 level German and English

 

A Quick Snapshot….. 

As an Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, spearheading efforts to uncover and nurture new business prospects while strengthening connections with our current clientele. Your role will involve deeply understanding client requirements, crafting personalized solutions, and ensuring top-notch customer satisfaction. Collaborating closely with Sales Engineering, Business/Sales Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners and clients, your primary focus will be on prospecting, managing and closing new business opportunities for enterprise-wide CONGA solutions with organizations across a variety of key strategic industries/verticals in the B2B space.  

Why it’s big deal…  

You'll have the chance to sell high-impact, mission-critical projects with substantial value, driving transformational change for our clients in Central Europe. Your role will involve skillfully crafting and implementing territory, account, and opportunity plans to optimize revenue within your assigned selling patch. You'll expertly manage sales opportunities throughout every stage of the cycle, ensuring success for both our clients and our company. 

Are you the person we are looking for?  

Proven track record. You have at least 5 years successful B2B technology Enterprise sales experience in the SaaS industry, in Central Europe. 

  • Proficiency in revenue management principles is crucial. 
  • You have a consistent track record of over achieving quota and revenue targets.  
  • You cultivate and leverage strategic relationships with partners to drive mutual business growth and success. 
  • Knowledge and experience in general AI and machine learning can bring significant value. You understand how AI can enhance revenue management processes. 

Hunter mentality. You'll have the opportunity to unleash your inner hunter and drive our growth through relentless pursuit of new business opportunities. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your strategic mindset and tenacity to identify, pursue, and close deals with potential clients. The focus is 90% new business. 

Solution Selling. Collaborate with prospects and clients to understand their unique challenges and business goals. Present Conga's comprehensive suite of solutions and services that align with clients' needs, demonstrating a deep understanding of how Conga can provide value. 

Drive. You have the ability to successfully leverage resources and take initiative. The most successful Conga reps are the ones who stop at nothing to achieve success no matter the circumstance. 

Communication: You have the ability to articulate complex technology concepts to a technical and non-technical audience. You also have superb listening skills and you understand objections and overcome them by turning skeptics into enthusiastic new customers and brand ambassadors. You possess Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Growth Mindset. As the business landscape is constantly evolving you adapt to changes in market conditions, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics. You innovate and develop creative solutions to address challenges and capitalize on opportunities in the revenue management space. 

Collaboration.  You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional value to our clients and drive mutual success. Together, we'll leverage each other's expertise and insights to achieve our goals and surpass expectations. You have the gravitas to lead a winning team, leveraging the strengths and skills of the organization to deliver profitable business to the organization. 

What will give you an edge... 

Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with a good understanding of CPQ, revenue optimization, CLM, doc-gen and e-signature products. 

Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research considered a plus.

 

 

Did we pique your interest?  

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format 

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Corporate Account Executive - Public Sector
description:
What will you be doing?

As Corporate Account Executive, Public Sector, you will own new-logo acquisition across a defined vertical and account set in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. Your focus will be public sector organisations with 2,000–7,499 employees. This is a dedicated new-business role and you are unlikely to inherit existing customers.

You will use available account, industry and SKU growth data to create, own and execute a clear territory strategy focused on sustainable net-new ARR growth. You will manage the full sales cycle—from prospecting and opportunity creation through procurement, negotiation and close—while building trusted relationships with business, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.

This is a self-sourcing role. You will have access to Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Partner Account Management and marketing resources, but this support is intended to complement—not replace—your personal accountability for creating pipeline. As a channel-first organisation, close alignment with the Partner Account Manager and partner ecosystem will be central to how you develop routes to market, generate demand and win business. Customer Success support will become available once a customer reaches the applicable ARR threshold.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Creating, validating, owning and executing a data-led territory and account plan that sets out how you will achieve an annual net-new ARR target of approximately $900,000 USD once fully ramped.
  • Using account intelligence, industry trends, SKU performance and growth data to prioritise target accounts, identify whitespace and focus resources on the strongest ARR opportunities.
  • Personally sourcing pipeline through disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, networking, events, social selling and account-based activity.
  • Working with the BDR to increase coverage and accelerate opportunity creation, while retaining personal ownership of pipeline generation and territory performance.
  • Leading new-logo acquisition across assigned public sector accounts within your defined vertical, with no reliance on an inherited customer base.
  • Managing the full sales cycle from initial engagement and qualification through discovery, solution development, business case, procurement, negotiation and close.
  • Operating effectively within a channel-first model by working closely with the PAM to build and execute partner-led account plans and routes to market.
  • Developing productive relationships with resellers, framework providers, distributors, system integrators and strategic alliance partners to create pipeline and close business.

title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI

Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.

We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.

This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.

What You'll Do

You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:

  • Designing and shipping end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more
  • Crossing organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission
  • Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity
  • Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions

You Should Have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience; you've built with LLMs extensively — whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself
  • Strong product instincts: you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec
  • LLM fluency: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos
  • Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js—you can own a feature end to end
  • An entrepreneurial drive: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do
  • Excellent communication: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself
  • An audacious appetite for impact: you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)
  • Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications

How We Work

  • We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together
  • We have the latest hardware and software—including frontier AI models on day one
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best
  • Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs

Why This Role Is Special

  • Your work is visible: This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction
  • Real stakes: thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact
  • Full ownership: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours
  • You're early: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it

 

What's in it for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. title: Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.

The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.

You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.

What you'll do

You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.

  • Lead and develop the team: Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.
  • Build dependable data foundations: Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.
  • Strengthen production ML: Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.
  • Advance marketplace models: Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.
  • Set direction and priorities: Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.
  • Shape the technology strategy: Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.

What you'll bring

You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.

Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.

  • Technical depth in one discipline: Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.
  • People leadership: Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.
  • Architecture and systems thinking: Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.
  • Production ML understanding: Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.
  • Business and product judgement: Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.
  • Relevant cloud platform experience: We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.
  • Streaming and integration experience: Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.
  • Clear communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How we work

  • You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.
  • The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.
  • Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.
  • The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.

Where you'll be

This is a hybrid role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

  • Experience building search, discovery, indexing, or information-retrieval features

In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who

description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye. 

About this role

This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.
 
We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements — powering learning and capability-building at scale. Legal sits at the center of all three motions.
 
You will be a dedicated legal partner for B2B Enterprise, Technology Alliances, and Channel and Distribution Partnerships, supporting the development and negotiation of the indirect partner ecosystem that underpins our scalable distribution. This is a role for someone who combines deep transactional expertise with strong business instincts, operates with a high degree of independence, and is ready to grow into broader leadership responsibility within a scaling legal function.

About your skills

  • Exceptional business judgement and a proven ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives in fast-moving deal environments.

  • Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex issues into clear, actionable guidance and influence stakeholders from SMB to large enterprise and C-suite.

  • A track record of using approved AI tools to increase legal productivity, and staying current on AI governance obligations.

What you’ll be doing  

B2B Enterprise, Ecosystems and Technology Transactions

  • Take primary ownership of drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.

  • Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and Product teams, on deal structuring, risk allocation, commercial terms, and multi-jurisdictional GTM considerations, serving as the day-to-day legal lead who positions Legal as a genuine business enabler.

  • Partner with the Product Legal team to develop and refine legal frameworks that support a self-serve and low-touch commercial motion, including API access agreements, developer terms, usage-based licensing structures, and SMB onboarding frameworks, contributing to a standardized, scalable approach that enables businesses to engage and onboard with speed and minimal friction.

  • Provide clear, solution-focused guidance on AI-related commercial arrangements, data-sharing agreements, and emerging technology implementations as they enter the enterprise deal mix.

  • Own and continuously develop the suite of enterprise and channel contracting templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and approval frameworks used across the partnerships function.

  • Design scalable legal infrastructure that empowers fast-moving deal teams to execute efficiently while maintaining sound risk controls across both direct and indirect channels.

  •  

GTM Product Commercialisation and Third-Party Integration

  • Act as a primary legal partner for the commercialisation of GTM products, advising on go-to-market structures, route-to-market models, pricing and packaging frameworks, and the legal terms that govern how products are brought to market directly and through third parties.

title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
description: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt. Das Team Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen. Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab. Deine Aufgaben Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt. Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand. Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan. Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir. Nach wem wir suchen Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein Deine ersten 90 Tage: Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt. Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert. Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen. Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt. Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte.. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Jede Messe bringt uns mit Unternehmen zusammen, deren Energiekosten wir senken und deren Verbrauch wir dekarbonisieren. Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Event-Marketing bei trawa ist im Aufbau. Du erbst keine fertigen Strukturen, sondern etablierst sie. Flexibles Arbeiten: Dich erwartet ein schönes Büro in Berlin mit einer lebendigen Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten sind möglich, 30 Urlaubstage unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Weiterbildungstage, ein jährliches L&D-Budget und Coaching-Sessions über Sparrks. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the Team Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies. We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all. About the role Join us as a Lead Software Engineer to spearhead the technical direction and delivery of complex, innovative AI and software projects. You will act as a technical expert, applying your skills across various projects from solution architecture to client-side deployments, while ensuring engineering decisions are sound and reliable. This role demands deep technical expertise and a genuine curiosity for solving hard engineering problems, focusing on driving innovation and building reusable solutions across the organisation. If you're ready to get hands-on with practical, innovative outcomes, this is your chance to shape our future. What you'll be doing Setting the technical direction for complex ML and software projects, balancing trade-offs, and guiding team priorities Architecting, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML/software systems, and justifying key architectural decisions. Defining project problems, developing roadmaps, and overseeing delivery across multiple workstreams in often ill-defined, high-risk environments. Driving the development of shared resources and libraries across the organisation and guiding other engineers in contributing to them. Leading hiring processes, making informed selection decisions, and mentoring multiple individuals to foster team growth. Proactively developing and executing recommendations for adopting new technologies, tools and changing our ways of working to stay ahead of the competition. Acting as a technical expert and coach for customers, accurately estimating large work-streams and defending rationale to stakeholders. Who we're looking for You are a technical expert among your peers, capable of going deep on particular topics and demonstrating breadth of knowledge to solve almost any problem. You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems. You are an expert in at least one major Cloud Solution Provider (e.g., Azure, GCP, AWS) and have led teams to build full-stack web applications. You have hands-on experience with containerisation tools like Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes. You can successfully guide and support a team of engineers, helping them deliver great work for clients. You find novel, clever solutions for project delivery and take ownership for successful project outcomes. You're an excellent communicator who can proactively help customers achieve their goals and guide both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders. Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Introduction to the role (45 minutes) Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes) System Design Interview (90 minutes) Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. raw.title: Lead Software Engineer
raw.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role

Join us as a Lead Software Engineer to spearhead the technical direction and delivery of complex, innovative AI and software projects. You will act as a technical expert, applying your skills across various projects from solution architecture to client-side deployments, while ensuring engineering decisions are sound and reliable.

This role demands deep technical expertise and a genuine curiosity for solving hard engineering problems, focusing on driving innovation and building reusable solutions across the organisation. If you're ready to get hands-on with practical, innovative outcomes, this is your chance to shape our future.

What you'll be doing

  • Setting the technical direction for complex ML and software projects, balancing trade-offs, and guiding team priorities

  • Architecting, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML/software systems, and justifying key architectural decisions.

  • Defining project problems, developing roadmaps, and overseeing delivery across multiple workstreams in often ill-defined, high-risk environments.

  • Driving the development of shared resources and libraries across the organisation and guiding other engineers in contributing to them.

  • Leading hiring processes, making informed selection decisions, and mentoring multiple individuals to foster team growth.

  • Proactively developing and executing recommendations for adopting new technologies, tools and changing our ways of working to stay ahead of the competition.

  • Acting as a technical expert and coach for customers, accurately estimating large work-streams and defending rationale to stakeholders.

Who we're looking for

  • You are a technical expert among your peers, capable of going deep on particular topics and demonstrating breadth of knowledge to solve almost any problem.

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

  • You are an expert in at least one major Cloud Solution Provider (e.g., Azure, GCP, AWS) and have led teams to build full-stack web applications.

  • You have hands-on experience with containerisation tools like Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes.

  • You can successfully guide and support a team of engineers, helping them deliver great work for clients.

  • You find novel, clever solutions for project delivery and take ownership for successful project outcomes.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can proactively help customers achieve their goals and guide both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the role (45 minutes)

  3. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  4. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

  • Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

  • GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

  • Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

  • Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

  • Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

  • Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship

  • Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology

  • Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same

  • Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company

  • Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work

  • Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features

  • Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work

  • Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit

  • Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams

  • Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it

Bonus

  • Experience at a high-growth AI/ML, developer tools, or API-first company

  • Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology

  • Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies

  • Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms

  • Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers

  • Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments

Location

Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach! Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben. Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen. Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital. Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte und Patienten versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen. Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes? Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter. Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit wachsendem Team übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion. Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du dabei, unsere Vision zu verwirklichen und die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege nachhaltig zu verbessern. Qualifikation Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum. Erfahrung mit großen Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf. Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren großen Kunden den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen. Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil. Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit). Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung. Benefits Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit Arbeitsplatz in unserem brandneuen Büro am Mehringdamm im Herzen Berlin-Kreuzbergs, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eine ganze Funktion und arbeitest direkt an der Seite der hellomed-Gründer – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen. Du erhältst monatlich 50 € steuerfreien Sachbezug (gesetzlicher Höchstbetrag), frei einlösbar bei über 100 Marken wie Amazon, REWE, IKEA oder Urban Sports Club. Alternativ erstatten wir dir dein Deutschlandticket. Wir verstehen, dass das Leben flexibel sein muss. Daher bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit 2 Tagen Home-Office pro Woche in einer geregelten 5-Tage-Woche. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Dienstwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung, um dich bei Kundenterminen und Reisen optimal zu unterstützen. Du hast 27 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit. Wir versorgen dich täglich mit Getränken, und bei regelmäßigen Teamevents sorgen wir für unvergessliche gemeinsame Momente. Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Du hast jederzeit die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzubilden oder Schulungen zu besuchen. Hast du Interesse? Dann bewirb dich direkt über unser Online-Formular auf JOIN. title: Managing Director (m/f/d) - Focus on Accounting & Office
description:
This role is part of our Central Finance Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400+ colleagues spanning 45 countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 24 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Managing Director to lead SaaS.group GmbH, our German legal entity based in Schönefeld. In this role, you will serve as the registered Managing Director on-site, exercising real decision-making authority, managing office administration, and overseeing day-to-day accounting operations. You will serve as the local face of the company for authorities, banks, auditors, and external service providers while working in close alignment with our Central Legal, Accounting, and Finance teams.

 

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced finance or office management professional based in the Berlin/Brandenburg region looking to step up into an official corporate leadership role within an international, fast-growing software group.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Seamlessly transition into the registered Managing Director role for SaaS.group GmbH and establish effective on-site operational processes in Schönefeld.
  • Assume complete oversight of local bookkeeping (payables, receivables, document management) and streamline month-end close workflows.
  • Build strong working relationships with our external tax advisors, auditors, banks, and internal group accounting/legal functions.
  • Ensure full compliance with all corporate-law requirements, commercial register obligations, and internal rules of procedure.

Your responsibilities

  • Manage SaaS.group GmbH on-site in Schönefeld, taking full ownership of approvals, contract execution, and payment authorizations within defined rules of procedure.
  • Run and oversee day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts payable/receivable, document organization, and preparation of month-end closing activities.
  • Collaborate closely with tax advisors and auditors on VAT filings, annual financial statements, and audit processes.
  • Maintain strict compliance with German corporate-law obligations, including commercial register filings, transparency register updates, and shareholder resolutions.
  • Lead office management and operational setup in Schönefeld, managing incoming mail, vendor/service provider contracts, archiving, and filing systems.
  • Act as the primary local point of contact for the German tax office (Finanzamt), financial institutions, local authorities, and insurers.

     

What You bring to the table

  • Vocational training in a commercial field (e.g., Tax Clerk / Steuerfachangestellte/r, Certified Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter/in, Office Management) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Multi-year background in accounting, financial administration, or senior office management.
  • Strong proficiency with DATEV (or comparable accounting software) as well as modern digital tools (MS Office / Google Workspace).
  • Fluency in German and good working proficiency in English to collaborate effectively across our international group.
  • Willingness to assume corporate liability and responsibility as a registered Managing Director (leadership experience is a plus, but not required).
  • Residence in the Berlin/Brandenburg region with the requirement for regular, physical presence at our Schönefeld office.

What's in it for You

  • Real Responsibility: A genuine Managing Director role with clear rules of procedure, corporate protection (D&O insurance included), and direct collaboration with the group CFO.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning  and expertise with each other internally. 
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. 

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. description:

Our Solutions Engineer will be responsible for the integration, validation, and operational readiness of Auterion-powered drone systems. You’ll collaborate closely with the production team, as well hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, and operations while ensuring that every platform transitions successfully from a physical airframe into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes drone technology and enjoys bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance.

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges
  • Perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 and/or other autopilot  ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up
  • Execute End-of-Line (EoL) software validation and functional testing to ensure production readiness and reliability
  • Conduct payload and camera load-seat testing, validating integration stability and operational performance under real-world conditions
  • Troubleshoot embedded system issues spanning firmware, communication interfaces, sensors, and hardware-software interactions
  • Work independently to diagnose integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams
  • Contribute to validation workflows for complete UAV systems, including components, integrated features, and operational flight configurations
  • Support full-stack drone integration activities across hardware, embedded firmware, and flight software layers
  • Solve complex integration and reliability challenges involving sensors, flight controllers, communication protocols, and power systems
  • Drive measurable impact on product quality, manufacturing throughput, and deployment readiness through improved validation and testing processes
  • Partner cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to accelerate batch validation and reduce EoL cycle times
  • Interface with external vendors and equipment providers to support testing infrastructure, hardware integration, and operational readiness
  • Participate in hands-on flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. in Aviation Technology, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional)
  • Hands-on experience working with Autopilot, Mission planning and navigation Software, including firmware flashing, configuration, and flight validation
  • Strong technical foundation in embedded systems, firmware debugging, and hardware-software integration
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and/or MAVLink communication protocols or equivalent Datalink protocols
  • Experience with UAV sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and flight controller configuration
  • Familiarity with Linux-based development and debugging environments
  • Experience with UAV flight testing, system validation, and troubleshooting in real-world operational environments
  • Understanding of drone manufacturing, QC processes, and End-of-Line testing methodologies is a plus
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with cross-functional engineering and operations teams
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments with evolving technical challenges
  • Passion for drone technology and a hands-on engineering mindset focused on building reliable flying systems
  • EU citizenship required

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. 

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.
  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.

  • Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.
  • Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.
  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As Chief of Staff, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.

Portfolio Value Creation

Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

 

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

  • Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume

  • Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

  • Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

  • New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

  • Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

  • Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

  • Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

 

Who you are

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

  • Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

  • Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

  • Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

  • Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

  • A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following

  • Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

 

What makes this exciting

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

 

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.
